<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 127.0997 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ~126.0924 Da. The formula C₇H₁₂NO matches this exact mass (calculated neutral mass 126.0919 Da, [M+H]+ 127.0992 Da), fitting within the instrument’s high‑resolution error. Therefore the molecular formula is C7H12NO.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H12NO</final_answer>
